notes: Only the VBA code was analyzed. Workbook data, cell contents and UserForm layouts were not available.
Entities, fields and screen controls are inferred from how the code uses sheets, ranges, forms and message boxes.
Every element lists the procedures it came from in source_ref.

entities.name: OrderLine
entities.description: Represents a single line item in an order, containing product SKU, quantity, and unit price.

fields.name: Sku
fields.notes: Corresponds to the SKU field in the OrderLine type

fields.name: Quantity
fields.notes: Corresponds to the Quantity field in the OrderLine type

fields.name: UnitPrice
fields.notes: Corresponds to the UnitPrice field in the OrderLine type

entities.name: InventoryItem
entities.description: Represents an inventory item with stock levels, usage metrics and valuation used for reorder calculations and ABC classification.

fields.name: OnHand
fields.notes: Current quantity on hand, used in NeedsReorder, SuggestedOrderQty, DaysOfStock

fields.name: ReorderPoint
fields.notes: Threshold quantity that triggers a reorder, used in NeedsReorder

fields.name: LeadTimeDays
fields.notes: Supplier lead time in days, used in NeedsReorder and SuggestedOrderQty

fields.name: AvgDailyUsage
fields.notes: Average daily consumption, used in multiple calculations

fields.name: PackSize
fields.notes: Quantity per purchase pack, used in SuggestedOrderQty

fields.name: AnnualValue
fields.notes: Yearly monetary value of the item, used in ClassifyAbc

fields.name: TotalValue
fields.notes: Total value of all items for ABC share calculation

rules.name: GetTierDiscount
rules.description: Returns a discount rate based on the customer's tier: Silver = 5 %, Gold = 10 %, Platinum = 15 %, otherwise 0 %.

rules.name: GetVolumeDiscount
rules.description: Returns a discount rate based on the ordered quantity: ≥100 → 12 %, ≥50 → 8 %, ≥10 → 3 %, otherwise 0 %.

rules.name: GetTaxRate
rules.description: Returns the tax rate for a given region; specific rates for CA, NY, NJ, TX, zero for OR/MT/NH/DE, otherwise the default rate of 8 %.

rules.name: CalculateLineTotal
rules.description: Computes the line total by applying tier and volume discounts to the gross amount (quantity × unit price), capping the combined discount at 25 %, and rounding to two decimals.

rules.name: CalculateShipping
rules.description: Determines shipping cost based on subtotal, weight, and whether express shipping is selected; free shipping when subtotal ≥ 150 and not express. Weight tiers: ≤1 kg → 4.99, ≤5 kg → 9.99, ≤20 kg → 19.99, above 20 kg → 19.99 + 0.75 × (excess kg). Express shipping doubles the cost. Result rounded to two decimals.

rules.name: ApplyPromoCode
rules.description: Applies a promotional discount to the subtotal: WELCOME10 gives 10 % off, SAVE20 subtracts $20 if subtotal ≥ 200, otherwise no change.

rules.name: CalculateOrderTotal
rules.description: Aggregates line totals for all order lines, applies any promotional code, adds shipping cost, computes tax based on region, and returns the final order total.

rules.name: NeedsReorder
rules.description: Determines whether inventory should be reordered by comparing on‑hand quantity to the reorder point and by projecting stock after lead time using average daily usage.

rules.name: SuggestedOrderQty
rules.description: Computes the recommended purchase quantity, rounding up to the nearest pack size and adding a safety buffer based on lead time and average daily usage.

rules.name: ClassifyAbc
rules.description: Assigns an ABC category (A, B, or C) to an item based on its share of total annual value; >=20% = A, >=5% = B, otherwise C.

rules.name: SafeDivide
rules.description: Divides numerator by denominator and returns 0 if division would cause an error (e.g., divide‑by‑zero).

rules.name: SumPositive
rules.description: Aggregates only the positive numbers from an array of numeric values.

rules.name: DaysOfStock
rules.description: Estimates how many days current inventory will last given average daily usage; returns a large sentinel value when usage is zero.

rules.name: MonthlyPayment
rules.description: Calculates the monthly payment for a loan given principal, annual interest rate (percent) and term in years, using the standard amortizing loan formula and rounding to two decimals.

rules.name: TotalInterest
rules.description: Computes total interest paid over the life of a loan by multiplying the monthly payment by the total number of payments and subtracting the principal, rounding to two decimals.

rules.name: BuildAmortization
rules.description: Generates a full amortization schedule as a two‑dimensional array (period, interest, principal, remaining balance) for each month of the loan term, rounding monetary values to two decimals.

rules.name: NetPresentValue
rules.description: Calculates the net present value of a series of cash flows discounted at a given annual rate (percent), summing each cash flow divided by (1+rate) raised to the period offset, rounding to two decimals.

rules.name: NormalizeSku
rules.description: Converts a raw SKU to uppercase, replaces spaces and underscores with hyphens, and truncates to 12 characters

rules.name: IsValidEmail
rules.description: Checks that an email address contains exactly one '@' and a '.' after the '@' and before the end of the string

rules.name: ToTitleCase
rules.description: Converts a string to title case by capitalizing the first letter of each word

rules.name: IsValidLuhn
rules.description: Validates a numeric string using the Luhn algorithm (checksum)

rules.name: ParseTier
rules.description: Converts a tier description string to the corresponding CustomerTier enum value using case‑insensitive matching

reports.name: OrderSummary
reports.description: Generates a summary sheet listing each order (OrderId, Sku, Region, Total) and a grand total for all processed orders
